verdict.rationale: ROS 2's source and documentation are published in public GitHub repositories (github.com/ros2/ros2, ros2/ros2_documentation), and a community member independently says ROS is open source. The evidence never names the specific license, so the openness claim rests on public hosting plus community corroboration. Missing for 10: the specific open-source license is not named in the evidence, and there are no first-party docs describing licensing terms.
